_comment: Curated bundles. Editorial: the title, blurb, audience and difficulty are our own words; every item is a catalog listing id. `scripts/check-bundles.mjs` (part of `npm run lint`) fails when an id is missing from the catalog or `litespm install` cannot complete it, so nothing here can quietly go stale. `litespm install` takes exactly one id per command, so a bundle installs as one command per line.

bundles.title: Agent Engineering Superpowers
bundles.blurb: The complete official Superpowers development methodology: systematic planning, test-driven development, rigorous debugging, subagent orchestration, worktrees, code reviews, and verification before completion.
bundles.audience: Developers wanting a disciplined, autonomous agent workflow

bundles.title: Full-stack web dev
bundles.blurb: Manage the repo, drive a real browser to test what you build, look up current library docs, and deploy, all from the agent.
bundles.audience: Web developers shipping an app

bundles.title: Office documents
bundles.blurb: Anthropic's official document skills: read and produce PDFs, Word documents, spreadsheets and slide decks.
bundles.audience: Anyone who works with documents

bundles.title: Databases
bundles.blurb: Hosted Postgres from Supabase and Neon, plus vendor skills for Neon Postgres and MongoDB schema and query work.
bundles.audience: Developers building on Postgres or MongoDB

bundles.title: Docs-grounded coding
bundles.blurb: Stop the agent guessing at APIs: current library documentation from Context7, plus web search from Brave.
bundles.audience: Anyone coding with an agent

bundles.title: Browser testing and QA
bundles.blurb: Playwright MCP to drive a browser, and Playwright skills that explore a site and generate tests.
bundles.audience: Developers and QA writing end-to-end tests

bundles.title: Errors and observability
bundles.blurb: Pull real production errors from Sentry and metrics from Grafana, then let the agent trace and fix them.
bundles.audience: Developers on call for a running service

bundles.title: Design to code
bundles.blurb: Read Figma files from the agent and turn them into components, with Playwright to check the result in a browser.
bundles.audience: Front-end developers working from Figma

bundles.title: Project tracking
bundles.blurb: Work with the trackers and wikis a team already uses: Linear issues, Notion pages and Atlassian (Jira and Confluence).
bundles.audience: Teams managing work in Linear, Notion or Jira

bundles.title: Payments with Stripe
bundles.blurb: Stripe's own MCP server plus its best-practices and documentation skills for building a checkout.
bundles.audience: Developers integrating Stripe payments

bundles.title: Cloud and infrastructure
bundles.blurb: Cloudflare's MCP server, Docker build and Compose guidance, and HashiCorp's Terraform policy skill.
bundles.audience: Engineers who run their own infrastructure

bundles.title: Build your own MCP server
bundles.blurb: Anthropic's skill for designing an MCP server, the Claude API reference, current docs from Context7, and GitHub to publish it.
bundles.audience: Developers writing MCP servers or Claude integrations

bundles.title: Vibe coding & rapid frontend
bundles.blurb: Prompt and ship animated UI components, animated slides and interactive blocks into your React/Next.js apps without writing boilerplate.
bundles.audience: Vibe coders, solo founders and indie hackers building fast

bundles.title: Designers & 3D visual assets
bundles.blurb: Figma design integration, real-world website visual inspiration galleries, CC0 3D models and game assets, plus PBR materials.
bundles.audience: Designers, 3D artists, and creative technologists

bundles.title: Application security & vulnerability audit
bundles.blurb: Proactively audit source code, inspect GitHub Actions CI workflows for supply chain risks, analyze vulnerability surface, and enforce secure coding standards.
bundles.audience: Security engineers, AppSec leads, and developers hardening code

bundles.title: Technical architect & code health
bundles.blurb: System architecture reviews, structural decision-making, automated bug discovery, and deep code reviews with clear rationale before merging.
bundles.audience: Tech leads, software architects, and engineering managers

bundles.title: Distributed backend & caching
bundles.blurb: Build high-throughput backends: Redis caching and rate-limiting, vector search indexing, Neon Postgres egress optimization, and Kafka event streaming stacks.
bundles.audience: Backend engineers building scalable APIs and distributed systems

bundles.title: Mobile apps & device testing
bundles.blurb: Build and test native mobile apps: Callstack device automation, Android ADB emulator controls, hosted iOS simulator execution, and Cocoa crash snapshot analysis.
bundles.audience: Mobile engineers, React Native devs, iOS and Android teams

bundles.title: AI Agents & SDK Development
bundles.blurb: Build autonomous multi-agent systems and LLM integrations with Vercel and Anthropic developer tools, skill creation workflows, documentation lookup, and full test-driven verification.
bundles.audience: Engineers developing AI agents, tools and custom workflows

bundles.title: AI Planning & Interactive Clarification
bundles.blurb: The most popular agent skills worldwide: find and load skills interactively, grill specs with docs, align design decisions, and explore web apps autonomously.
bundles.audience: Developers who want their agents to ask the right questions, explore APIs, and avoid assumptions

bundles.title: Programmatic Video & Motion UI
bundles.blurb: Render dynamic videos, keyframe transitions, and generative motion graphics using Remotion and React Three Fiber directly from agent prompts.
bundles.audience: Developers and creators automating video rendering, canvas motion, and dynamic social clips
